function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.vendor_id, pl.sku, pl.period,
       pl.unit_price_orig, pl.contract_unit_price,
       pl.qty, pl.fx_rate,
       (pl.unit_price_orig - pl.contract_unit_price) * pl.qty * pl.fx_rate AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
  AND pl.unit_price_orig > pl.contract_unit_price
ORDER BY pl.vendor_id, pl.sku, pl.period","purpose":"List purchase lines where unit price exceeds contract price for Aug and Sep 2026, compute excess CAD"}
